# Payments Platform

> Java 25 Spring Modulith payments platform: identity, payments, notifications, transactional outbox, Redis cache, RabbitMQ, and Kubernetes operations.

This is the machine-readable documentation index. Read the linked pages for current behavior; ADRs record immutable trade-offs.

## Overview

- [Documentation index](README.md): Human entry point and documentation map.
- [Architecture](architecture.md): Module boundaries, Clean Architecture, CQRS, outbox, security, and runtime flows.
- [HTTP API](api.md): Routes, authorization, validation, pagination, idempotency, and RFC 7807 errors.
- [Postman](postman.md): Complete ordered examples, collection variables, token reuse, payload tests, optional fraud review, and Newman.
- [Postman validation](test-plans/postman-validation.md): Real local API execution, 30 examples, 105 assertions, and Newman export caveat.
- [Refactor validation](test-plans/refactor-validation.md): Strict local CI results, Kubernetes validation, 154 Maven tests, and the outbox fixture isolation fix.
- [Data model](data.md): Flyway migrations, constraints, indexes, and schema/query reconciliation notes.
- [Concurrency](concurrency.md): Optimistic locking, virtual-thread rules, cache stampede protection, leases, and batched outbox claims.
- [Resilience](resilience.md): Fraud-screening retries, circuit breakers, bulkheads, time limits, and fallback policy.
- [Messaging](messaging.md): Outbox relay, RabbitMQ routing, retry, deduplication, and DLQ behavior.
- [Observability](observability.md): Tracing, metrics, logs, queue depth, and local dashboards.
- [Testing](testing.md): Unit/integration gates, Testcontainers, Colima, Newman, and k6.
- [Deployment](deploy.md): Local stack, migration job, Kubernetes overlays, rollback, and smoke checks.
- [Refactor and validation rules](rules/refactor-and-validation.md): Prevention rules and executable evaluations.
- [API authentication context rule](rules/api-auth-context.md): `CurrentUser` schema-hiding invariant.

## Architecture decisions

- [ADR index](adr/README.md): Accepted and superseded decisions.
- [ADR 0014](adr/0014-web-boundary-and-strict-local-gate.md): Application boundary for notifications and strict local validation.
- [ADR 0015](adr/0015-virtual-thread-hot-paths.md): Password hashing off the virtual-thread carriers and outside transactions, batched outbox relay, compact object headers, and the Java 25 features not adopted.
